liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Jerry's second solo in this track is highlighted as a standout moment for fans; The first solo starts casually, then accelerates rapidly after a snare kick, flowing lyrically [15][18]
- **Lost Sailor** (1 review): The transition from Lost Sailor to Saint Of Circumstance is praised as a favorite [17]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): The transition from Space into Iko Iko is described as a hidden treat with nice vocals [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-08-10.mtx.seamons.86585.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 186 min; rated 4.45/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: The soundboard can sound scratchy during loud parts, likely due to set one technical issues [1]
- **gd1982-08-10.mtx.seamons.fix.92073.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 186 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [2]
- **gd1982-08-10.145223.fob.beyer.m160.streeter.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: soundboard; 25 songs; 185 min [4]. Said about its sound: Frank's masters have dropouts in Set I due to a faulty mic cable, patched in places [4]
- **gd82-08-10.sbd.miller.12453.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 175 min; rated 4.65/5 by 63 [9]. Said about its sound: Bobby remarked the acoustics felt like a tin box, yet the recording quality is good [23]

## Around the show

- High energy in the field house marked the end of the west/midwest tour [21]
- Police directed fans to a camping spot after the show, a surprisingly cool scene [23]
- The performance is cited as evidence of the band's best run since 1977 [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-08-10.mtx.seamons.86585.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: MATRIX MIX: 50%AUD/50%SBD [1]
- **gd1982-08-10.mtx.seamons.fix.92073.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Hunter Seamons; source: About 50%AUD/50%SBD [2]. Also: Taped by Kenny Mance using AKG CE-1 mics and a UHER CR-240 recorder [2]
- **gd1982-08-10.145223.fob.beyer.m160.streeter.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Frank Streeter; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Beyer M160's > Sony TC-D5M > Cassette Master (TDK MA90) - Taped by Frank Streetereg: SBD > DAT [4]
- **gd82-08-10.sbd.miller.12453.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]
